96	/**
97	 * Initial-state inputs for `createHeadlessSessionStore`. Lives in agent
98	 * because the consumer (`buildHeadlessCompatState`) does — moves agent
99	 * out of cli's dep graph (V7 §3.2 / §8 coupling rule).
100	 */
101	export type HeadlessStoreParams = {
102	  mcpClients: MCPServerConnection[]
103	  mcpCommands: McpCommand[]
104	  mcpTools: Tool[]
105	  toolPermissionContext: ToolPermissionContext
106	  effort: string | undefined
107	  effectiveModel: string | null
108	  advisorModel?: string
109	  kairosEnabled?: boolean
110	}

112	// `Store<T>`: `@thyrox/app-host` no expone `state/store.ts` — ver
113	// docstring. Forma erosionada mínima para que los dos alias de abajo
114	// typechequen con la misma forma pública que la fuente.
115	// biome-ignore-all assist/source/organizeImports: tipo local sustituto (ver docstring)
116	type Store<T> = {
117	  getState: () => T
118	  setState: (next: T) => void
119	  subscribe: (listener: (state: T) => void) => () => void
120	}
121	
122	export type InteractiveSessionStore = Store<AppState>
123	export type HeadlessSessionStore = Store<AppState>
124	
125	export function createInteractiveSessionStore(
126	  initialState?: AppState,
127	): InteractiveSessionStore {
128	  // `createStore` y `onChangeAppState`: @thyrox/app-host no expone
129	  // `state/store.ts` y @thyrox/repl no existe — ver docstring del módulo.
130	  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports
131	  const { createStore } = require('@thyrox/app-host/state/store.js') as {
132	    createStore: <T>(initial: T, onChange: (state: T) => void) => Store<T>
133	  }
134	  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports
135	  const { onChangeAppState } = require('@thyrox/repl/onChangeAppState.js') as {
136	    onChangeAppState: (state: AppState) => void
137	  }
138	  return createStore<AppState>(
139	    initialState ?? getDefaultAppState(),
140	    onChangeAppState,
141	  )
142	}

144	function buildHeadlessCompatState(
145	  params: HeadlessStoreParams,
146	): AppState {
147	  const defaultState = getDefaultAppState()
148	  const hostState = projectHostSessionState(defaultState)
149	  // `getInitialSettings`: @thyrox/config no expone `settings` con esta
150	  // forma — ver docstring del módulo.
151	  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports
152	  const { getInitialSettings } = require('@thyrox/config/settings') as {
153	    getInitialSettings: () => {
154	      effortLevel?: EffortLevel
155	      fastModePerSessionOptIn?: boolean
156	      fastMode?: boolean
157	    }
158	  }
159	  const initialSettings = getInitialSettings()
160	  const initialEffortValue =
161	    parseEffortValue(params.effort) ??
162	    toPersistableEffort(initialSettings.effortLevel)
163	  // `isFastModeEnabled`/`getFastModeUnavailableReason`/
164	  // `isFastModeSupportedByModel`: @thyrox/provider no expone `fastMode.ts`
165	  // — ver docstring del módulo.
166	  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports
167	  const fastModeMod = require('@thyrox/provider/fastMode.js') as {
168	    isFastModeEnabled: () => boolean
169	    getFastModeUnavailableReason: () => string | null
170	    isFastModeSupportedByModel: (model: string | null) => boolean
171	  }
172	  const initialFastMode =
173	    fastModeMod.isFastModeEnabled() &&
174	    fastModeMod.getFastModeUnavailableReason() === null &&
175	    fastModeMod.isFastModeSupportedByModel(params.effectiveModel) &&
176	    !initialSettings.fastModePerSessionOptIn &&
177	    initialSettings.fastMode === true
178	
179	  // Cross-package types (MCPServerConnection / McpCommand / Tool /
180	  // ToolPermissionContext) are SDK boundary placeholders (V7 §7.2) —
181	  // each is a structural superset of the local AppState slot shape. The
182	  // construction is structurally sound; the named types are documentation
183	  // for SDK consumers, not internal type assertions.
184	  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
185	  return {
186	    ...hostState,
187	    ...defaultState,
188	    mcp: {
189	      ...defaultState.mcp,
190	      clients: params.mcpClients,
191	      commands: params.mcpCommands,
192	      tools: params.mcpTools,
193	    },
194	    toolPermissionContext: params.toolPermissionContext,
195	    effortValue: initialEffortValue,
196	    ...(fastModeMod.isFastModeEnabled() ? { fastMode: initialFastMode } : {}),
197	    ...(params.advisorModel ? { advisorModel: params.advisorModel } : {}),
198	    ...(feature('KAIROS') && params.kairosEnabled !== undefined
199	      ? { kairosEnabled: params.kairosEnabled }
200	      : {}),
201	  } as AppState
202	}

1	type Listener = () => void
2	type OnChange<T> = (args: { newState: T; oldState: T }) => void
3	
4	export type Store<T> = {
5	  getState: () => T
6	  setState: (updater: (prev: T) => T) => void
7	  subscribe: (listener: Listener) => () => void
8	}
9	
10	export function createStore<T>(
11	  initialState: T,
12	  onChange?: OnChange<T>,
13	): Store<T> {
14	  let state = initialState
15	  const listeners = new Set<Listener>()
16	
17	  return {
18	    getState: () => state,
19	
20	    setState: (updater: (prev: T) => T) => {
21	      const prev = state
22	      const next = updater(prev)
23	      if (Object.is(next, prev)) return
24	      state = next
25	      onChange?.({ newState: next, oldState: prev })
26	      for (const listener of listeners) listener()
27	    },
28	
29	    subscribe: (listener: Listener) => {
30	      listeners.add(listener)
31	      return () => listeners.delete(listener)
32	    },
33	  }
34	}
